intro: Put your mind and reflexes to the test in a retro-futuristic challenge!
description:
Put your mind and reflexes to the test!
Dive into Pattern Pulse, a retro-futuristic skill game ideal for quick gaming sessions. The title includes two game modes:

♠ Memory Mode (Pattern): Memorize and repeat increasingly long and complex sequences of lights on the color buttons.
♥ Speed Mode (Follow Mode): Test your reflexes by pressing the buttons instantly as they light up, accompanied by a fun animated character.

Features:
♦ Two distinct experiences: mental training and pure reflex action.
♣ Arcade aesthetic with vibrant neon lights.
♠ High score tracking to push your limits.
